items.title: Ampleness descends along a quasi-compact morphism: from the composite to the first factor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a morphism is quasi-compact and an invertible sheaf is ample for the composite of that morphism with a further morphism, then the sheaf is ample for the first morphism alone. The proof chooses an affine open in the base and an affine open of the middle scheme mapping into it, observes that the restriction of the sheaf to the preimage of the base affine is ample by hypothesis, and that the preimage of the middle affine sits inside it as a quasi-compact open immersion, so that the restriction is ample there too; the characterisation of relative ampleness by affine opens in the base then gives the conclusion.
